data.title: Four-Digit Place Value Explorer
data.description: Practice reading four-digit numbers with base-ten blocks, paying close attention to place values and interior zeros.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count each type of block carefully, remembering to look at the tens place.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Check the tens place carefully to see how many tens blocks are there.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones to find the total.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Look closely at the hundreds column to see if there are any flat blocks.
